Ivy: Quick Q 1: we hired an IC in EU who just got promoted internally. Their local payroll needs a comp adj and equity conversion. Best flow?

Noah (People Ops): Two things: (1) comp-change form for base/bonus, (2) equity conversion request for local equity plan. Include country and currency.

Luis (Eng Manager): Currency conversion  do we propose USD or local?

Sana (Comp): Propose in local currency with USD equivalent. Comp will run currency check + market comp for that country. Attach local market data if you have it.

Ivy: Timelines? payroll issues for international hires are tricky.

hr-bot: Intl payroll note: submit by the 5th for next-month effective for most regions; certain APAC payrolls need earlier cutoffs.

Noah (People Ops): Also legal needs to review equity conversion terms. That adds ~1 week. If you need faster, flag "urgent" and explain retention risk.

Luis (Eng Manager): Communication to employee  any special wording for conversion?

Sana (Comp): Use script: "Congrats on promo. We're initiating local pay adjustment and equity conversion; payroll/equity dates may differ; we'll confirm exact amounts once comp/legal finalize." Keep exact numbers tentative until approvals.

Ivy: Got it. I'll submit comp-change + conversion request and attach local market comps. Thanks all.

Noah (People Ops): Ping me after submission and I'll triage with Legal.
